note: Capability ids are stable strings. Adding an id does not change the wire protocol. This taxonomy is research terminology for discovery, not a license or credential.

categories.name: Legal / regulatory research

categories.disclaimer: Legal/regulatory research terminology only. This is not a substitute for a qualified legal professional. Capabilities in this category are research and drafting aids. They are not a lawyer, they do not form an attorney-client relationship, and their output is not legal advice. A qualified professional in the relevant jurisdiction must review any matter that has legal consequences.
